data.name: Sukant
data.gender_notes: Sukant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sukant is derived from the Sanskrit word 'suk' which means good, pleasant, happiness and 'kant' which means doer. The name implies a person who brings happiness and positivity to those around him. The name Sukant carries the meaning “Good, Pleasant, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sukant usually hope their child will grow to embody good, pleasant, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
